```yaml
name: Update Roadmap on Merge

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [closed]

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    if: github.event.pull_request.merged == true && github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Get last 10 merged PRs
        id: get_prs
        uses: actions/github-script@v6
        with:
          script: |
            const prs = await github.paginate(github.rest.pulls.list, {
              owner: context.repo.owner,
              repo: context.repo.repo,
              state: 'closed',
              sort: 'updated',
              direction: 'desc',
              per_page: 100
            });
            const merged = prs.filter(pr => pr.merged_at).slice(0, 10).map(pr => pr.number);
            core.setOutput('merged_prs', merged.join(','));

      - name: Update roadmap file
        run: |
          ROADMAP_FILE="ROADMAP.md"
          if [ ! -f "$ROADMAP_FILE" ]; then
            echo "Roadmap file not found!"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Extract content before the Released section
          pre=$(sed -n '1,/## 🚀 Released/p' "$ROADMAP_FILE" | head -n -1)

          # Extract content after the list (starting from the next heading)
          post=$(sed -n '/## 🚀 Released/,$p' "$ROADMAP_FILE" | tail -n +2 | sed -n '/^## /,$p' | tail -n +1)

          # Build new list of PRs
          IFS=',' read -ra PRS <<< "${{ steps.get_prs.outputs.merged_prs }}"
          list=""
          for pr in "${PRS[@]}"; do
            list+="- #${pr}\n"
          done

          # Assemble new content
          new_content="${pre}\n## 🚀 Released\n\n${list}\n${post}"
          echo "$new_content" > "$ROADMAP_FILE"

          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "$ROADMAP_FILE"
          git commit -m "Update roadmap with latest merged PRs" || echo "No changes to commit"
          git push
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
